title: Perchway Diagnostics private deploy daybook
content:
Topline: notes from kickoff + tech scoping call with Perchway Diagnostics (PD). Customer is a clinical diagnostics vendor building a triage assistant that summarizes device logs and HL7 lab streams. They must run inference entirely on-prem in their EU-FR data center (air-gapped preferred). This doc is messy — capture of decisions, performance targets, gotchas, config sketches, and next steps.

Attendees (2024-09-18 kickoff):
- Perchway: Marie Lam (SRE lead), Jonas Brecht (Platform eng), Dr. S. Khatri (Clinical ops PM)
- Redwood: Priya Nair (solutions), Carlos Mendes (oncall/devops), Riley Thompson (runtime eng)

Call record (quick bullets):
- PD: hard constraint = no traffic egress from on-prem; control plane can be allowed to contact Redwood over a dedicated VPN but must be limited.
- HSM/KMS: PD requires customer-managed HSM for key material. Need to validate KMS integration path for private package (HSM via PKCS#11).
- Throughput target: 200 req/min peak (single-shot text summarization plus metadata extraction). Typical inference payload ~600 tokens in, ~120 tokens out. SLA target: p95 < 350ms per token (per-token latency SLO) AND end-to-end p95 < 1.2s for median requests; negotiable for burst windows.
- Model choice: PD trialing rw-l2-13b-8k-qat (quantized) — runtime team recommended 8-bit q4_0 with KV cache warmup for session flows.
- Data sensitivity: logs contain PHI-like fields (patient IDs). PD will pipeline redaction rules pre-ingest; also want audit logs retained for 365 days (storage impact).

Immediate risks / gotchas noted: 
1) Air-gapped install + HSM: customer uses a vendor HSM that only supports PKCS#11 v2.40 and requires SNI-less mTLS for licensing handshake. Need engineering verification in Private package (we have limited testing on that exact HSM model).
2) KV cache sizing: session flows can reuse KV cache across long-lived sessions (some streams >5k tokens). With quantized model and 13B, KV memory blowup on 4x token windows if not evicted correctly — possible OOM on 1x A100 40GB. We should recommend dedicated 80GB or split-cache sharding.
3) Network topology: PD's edge network enforces strict egress; control-plane-only VPN might be allowed but ops wants minimal external calls. We need to confirm telemetry/heartbeat frequency and the option to run control-plane locally (private control plane) vs. light-control-plane with offline check-ins.
4) HIPAA-like audits: PD requested role-based access and fine-grained audit logs by default. Config for log PII masking in console needs to be validated.

Performance sketch / cost considerations: 
- Expected token mix: 600 in / 120 out -> ~720 total tokens per request. At 200 rpm -> 144k tokens/minute -> daily ~207M tokens. For quantized 13B model with batching, recommend: 2x 80GB GPU pool (one primary, one hot-standby) or a single 2-node sharded setup (to meet latency SLOs).
- Batching policy: continuous batching with max-latency 20ms, max-batch 8 for latency-sensitive calls. Use per-route batch hints in the configuration.

Recommended runtime config (sketch - for internal use):
---
route: pd-triage
model: rw-l2-13b-8k-qat
quantization_profile: q4_0
max_batch_size: 8
max_batch_delay_ms: 20
kv_cache_mode: sharded
kv_shards: 2
kv_eviction_policy: lru
hsm_integration: pkcs11
license_check: offline-token (30d)
telemetry: minimal -> heartbeat=600s, buffered-logs=false
persistent_audit: s3-compatible, retention_days=365
---
Notes: this is deliberately conservative for latency. If PD accepts p99 exceptions during daily large-batches, we can relax batch size.

Security / compliance notes: 
- HSM path: validate pkcs11 provider binary compatibility. Action: Carlos to request HSM vendor package and debug container image (Carlos, due 2024-09-25).
- AuthN: PD wants RBAC + SCIM provisioning. We have SCIM connector in Private but need to confirm mapping for their AD schema.
- Encryption at rest: PD will provide KMS root; ensure volumes are LUKS/DM-crypt on installer image.

Operational runbook items from call: 
- Canary plan: start on a single server with isolated tenant, run synthetic load (script under /tools/pd-load) for 48h. If p95 latency < SLO and no OOMs -> scale to 2 GPU nodes.
- Fallback: during maintenance, route requests to hosted fallback (only if customer permits egress). PD initially answers NO to hosted fallback — we need to offer a local degraded-mode: queueing + async webhook to downstream clinical app.
- Alerting: recommended alerts: OOM events, kv_cache_eviction_count > 1000/min, p95 latency > 1.2s, feature-flag mismatch on quantization.

Open questions (to resolve with PD or eng):
- Q1: Do they want persistent sessions (affects KV cache) vs stateless calls? Answer pending from Dr. Khatri.
- Q2: Can PD accept a small, periodic egress for license verification (every 30d)? PD ops currently says no. Need legal signoff for offline token.
- Q3: Which HSM model exactly? Need serial/model number to verify vendor compatibility.

Action items (owner / notes / due):
- Carlos Mendes: obtain HSM vendor package and run PKCS#11 smoke test in our private CI (due 2024-09-25).
- Riley Thompson: bench rw-l2-13b-8k-qat quantized binary on 80GB and 40GB instances, record KV memory growth for sequences up to 6k tokens (due 2024-09-29).
- Priya Nair: draft proposal (commercial + recommended architecture) and send to PD by 2024-10-04. Include options: (A) 2x80GB nodes reserved, (B) 2-node sharded 40GB with aggressive eviction, (C) full private control plane license.
- PD (Marie/Jonas): confirm whether hosted fallback is ever allowed and provide HSM model (due 2024-09-24).

Notes to self / heuristics: 
- Avoid promising hosted fallback unless legal signs off (customer is strict).
- If KV sharding required, prefer 2 shards over >3 to reduce cross-shard latency.
- Use quantization-preserving kernels we've tested in runtime v1.14+; do not ship 13B q4_0 on runtime <1.14. PR #1742 touches kernel selection logic — confirm it lands before customer install.

Conversation snippets (copied):
- Jonas: "We can't have any egress that leaks PHI, even for telemetry metadata."
- Marie: "We might allow a one-time license exchange if it can be done via USB token; no network calls."
- Dr. Khatri: "Latency is important for clinician workflow; if it takes >2s they will complain."

Next meeting: 2024-09-26 technical deep-dive (internal + PD engineers). Prepare: benchmarking matrix, HSM compatibility checklist, quick install plan for air-gapped scenario.

Rough install checklist (air-gapped):
- offline-installer.tar.gz (signed) + offline dependency tarball
- local package registry (apt/nginx proxy) instructions
- PKCS#11 provider + containerized test harness
- documented manual license activation via USB token or physical file
- disk encryption and audit log collector config

Backlog ideas / low-priority asks from PD:
- HL7-specific prebuilt redaction plugin (could be a paid addon).
- Prefer per-request redaction hooks to avoid storing PHI in logs.

End notes: messy, will clean before sending proposal. Keep this doc as canonical scratch until we convert to a short proposal doc.

[END]
